title: Mission priority file
description: Swappable input that sets what matters on this mission. The jury may hand us an unseen one, so the governor validates it before use and refuses a bad file with the field that is wrong, keeping the previous file meanwhile. YAML may write crew levels unquoted; the loader validates the file's JSON form, where they are strings.

weights.description: Weight 0 to 1 for every capability name a guest card can return.

shed_order.description: Optional declared shed order, keyed by capability name like weights. Precedence: safety-critical guests are never shed and hard limits come first; throttles come before sheds; then the criticality tier (tiers); then this order; then the least mission value lost per kW freed. A positive rank goes before every unlisted capability (1 first), a negative rank after them (-1 last); unlisted capabilities keep the computed order in between, and equal ranks fall back to it. A name that no loaded guest card returns is refused.

confirm.description: Optional crew policy per rule, keyed by rule name (rules in config/assumptions.yaml), replacing that rule's default at the crew levels given. confirm: a human confirms live; standing_plan: approved before it is needed; automatic; forbidden. Nobody aboard can confirm at 0 (brief A.6), so confirm is refused there. A rule name the ship profile does not define is refused.

tiers.description: Optional criticality tiers for graceful degradation (DEC-59), by guest id. Four tiers, degraded in this order: discretionary first, then mission support (every guest not listed), then mission_critical (the list above) last; vessel_critical is never shed under this profile, like a card's safety_critical. Throttles still come before sheds; within a tier the declared shed_order, then the least mission value lost per kW freed. A guest may sit in one tier only.

0.description: No live confirmation with nobody aboard (brief A.6).
